newScenarios: Ordinary restore: Completer blocks repository.replace; without pumping after confirm, system pop, modal barrier, stale cancel and repeated confirm cannot close or submit again; release commits exactly one replacement and one original protection.
Compatible restore: same events plus the stale checkbox callback cannot revoke preservation while saving; one protection is retained and 1000-character title/2001-character note survive intact.
Encrypted backup password: stale outer menu opens one dialog; first-frame back/cancel/repeated continue start one native KDF and one file-save callback; only successful file save closes it.
WebDAV settings: deviceId first await is blocked; first-frame route pop/repeated save enter once; synthetic store failure retains all five input fields and writes no secrets.
Sync enrollment: a synthetic HttpClient blocks the first enroll openUrl; first-frame route pop/stale authorize enter once; failure retains endpoint/invite and writes no configuration.

Conflict merge: delayed onApply blocks first-frame route pop/stale cancel/duplicate apply; failure retains manual selection/text; deliberate retry assembles the selected snapshot and saves once with one protected original.

Sync recovery password: first-frame route pop/stale cancel/duplicate save start one native recovery-file KDF/encryption and verified file-save callback; cancelled file save retains both password fields; deliberate retry succeeds once.

counterfactual.purpose: Demonstrate that the unchanged before-pump assertion detects the original restore race.
counterfactual.variant: Only BackupRestoreDialog comes from the stated Git baseline; supporting files are copied current files. The shared repository was never replaced.
counterfactual.testVersion: Same test assertions as the final test; precedes two brace-only lint fixes.
counterfactual.command: flutter test --no-pub test/save_inflight_race_test.dart --plain-name 'ordinary restore blocks back, barrier, cancel and repeated confirm before rebuilding'
counterfactual.expectedFailure: Expected empty completion results while replace was blocked; actual [null] proves premature route exit.
counterfactual.preparation: The fresh temporary workspace initially lacked cached SQLite native assets. Existing local hook assets were copied offline before the actual counterfactual run; no shared sources or toolchain settings changed.

evidenceLimits: This record covers host widget tests. It adds no Android/device or real external service claim.
The new merge widget case uses the real dialog, SyncEntities selection/assembly, HabitController and MemoryHabitRepository protection; it is not a new end-to-end SyncEngine/SQLite merge test.
WebDAV settings fail at the synthetic device store before networking; sync enrollment uses an injected synthetic HttpClient without sockets.
